The '''Master''' or '''Mistress of Lightsabers''' was a title given to the premiere [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] at the [[Almas Academy]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The Jedi which held this position was the local equivalent of the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]; the battlemaster elected an instructor for the position and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] confirmed the appointment.<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force real-life book">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] Confirms that all satellite academies' instructors are appointed by the High Council and the battlemaster proposes new ones.</ref>
